mode_note: Valorant-style buy-menu deathmatch: agent select + abilities, B buy menu, map reveal, first-to-30. Battle DOM is built in JS (ensureBattleDom) so it survives edge-cached HTML shells.
note: To update: rebuild zip (game/ contents at archive root: server.js + index.html + assets), upload via media_upload + PUT + media_confirm, then deploy_game with this exact game_id. The public URL serves an embed wrapper; the game itself runs in the #hf-frame iframe at ?__raw=1 (top-level browser visits to ?__raw=1 are redirected back to the wrapper — curl gets the raw page). Automated tests must drive the iframe. This container's proxy blocks the Higgsfield CDN/upload hosts; assemble inside sandbox_exec, pulling changed files from GitHub raw at a commit SHA.
